gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed GBM (primary) with unequivocal first progression of disease (confirmed by MRI or CT within 2 weeks of study registration).

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this research study is to test the feasibility of a Static Magnetic and Electric Field (sBE) Device when combined with standard chemotherapy drugs, Lomustine and Bevacizumab, in the treatment of patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have previous history of failing temozolamide and radiation with this being the first recurrence after standard of care therapy.

role_evidence.quote: The sBE device is to be used 8 hours a day by the patients, during sleep, for 8 weeks, while also receiving standard chemotherapy Lomustine and Bevacizumab

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent; standard recurrent GBM therapy
arms: Patients: sBE device applied during sleep, in combination with Lomustine and Bevacizumab

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody; standard recurrent GBM therapy
arms: Patients: sBE device applied during sleep, in combination with Lomustine and Bevacizumab

coder_notes: Phase NA device feasibility study (static magnetic and electric field device); lomustine and bevacizumab are standard background chemotherapy, not studied, so no pharmacological candidate (alternative label established_therapy_only). Second experimental arm enrols healthy bed partners exposed to the device only; not a control arm. Blood collection is for research on device effects, not drug target engagement.
